# Statistics Aggregation Processor

<!-- status autogenerated section -->
<!-- end autogenerated section -->

The Statistics Aggregation Processor receives spans from the Lookup Routing Processor and aggregates statistics about the processed spans.

## Configuration

The following configuration parameters are available:

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `export_window` | duration | `60s` | Time window for exporting aggregated statistics |

## Example Configuration

```yaml
processors:
  statisticsaggregation:
    export_window: 60s
```

## Pipeline Configuration

The processor should be placed after the Lookup Routing Processor in the pipeline:

```yaml
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      processors: [lookuprouting, statisticsaggregation]
```
